summary: Available September · Secure off road parking · Unfurnished
description:
A rare opportunity to rent this two bedroom, second floor apartment within this exclusive block located on Osborne Road, Jesmond. Set behind a private gated entrance, the apartment provides a quiet and secure, yet centrally located place to live. Through the communal entrance which features decorative period features, we climb to the second floor to be greeted by the apartment's front door.

Well presented throughout, the apartment offers ample space including large entrance hallway with storage cupboard. We go through to the living room which boasts decorative coving with hidden LEDs, transforming the room by night and are a real statement piece. A modern, compact kitchen with hand painted units and integrated appliances. The master bedroom is accompanied by the family bathroom. The second bedroom may be preferred as an office or spare bedroom.

The property has recently undergone extensive refurbishment works including tasteful decorations, period column radiators and modern, soundproofing sash windows which block out almost all road noise. Ideally situated on Osborne Road, the property benefits from excellent access to local shops, bars and other amenities.
